posts.t:
Hello Pippendale,

This is where experience and screen time come into play. You see, we have this little very cordial debate going on between Ifmyante and me about engulfings. He talks about engulfings for zones, I use pure engulfing candles. My only "must" to be valid is that the candle following the engulf is in the same direction, ie. a bear candle after a bear engulfing. there is not much i can tell you, it just works. Too often to be a fluke.

Try to train your eye and dont hesitate to ask questions. For me, they are the best supply and demand zones.

PS: Went to play squash at lunch time, got taken at break even.

سلام Pippendale،

اینجا تجربه و زمانِ پشت چارت وارد بازی می‌شود. ببین، یک بحث خیلی صمیمی و کوچک بین Ifmyante و من دربارهٔ اینگالف‌ها در جریان است. او دربارهٔ اینگالف‌ها برای ناحیه‌ها صحبت می‌کند، من از کندل‌های خالص اینگالف استفاده می‌کنم. تنها «باید» من برای معتبر بودن این است که کندل بعد از اینگالف در همان جهت باشد، یعنی یک کندل نزولی بعد از یک اینگالف نزولی. چیز زیادی نمی‌توانم به تو بگویم، فقط کار می‌کند. آن‌قدر تکرار می‌شود که شانسی نباشد.

posts.t:
Hello again,

I wanted to show you a precise and concrete example of what I meant.

Look at this gold chart. Price dropped, retraced, and look where it turned down again, and why...

This, my friend, is an engulfing. OK, this is not a large amazing candle, but it has engulfed, and the next one is down too. Good enough for me and at least a scalp. You can think, man, this could retrace a lot more. True, a lot more people would think so. But you need to know where and what to look for. And now, you know!

Hope this helps.

Have a great week end.
